verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַֽנַּעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ṣō·p̄ar han·na·‘ă·mā·ṯî way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Zophar the Naamathite . . . replied
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO respondeu Zofar, o naamatita, e disse:

verses.original: הֲרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֵעָנֶ֑ה וְאִם־ אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפָתַ֣יִם יִצְדָּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: hă·rōḇ də·ḇā·rîm lō yê·‘ā·neh wə·’im- ’îš śə·p̄ā·ṯa·yim yiṣ·dāq
verses.literal: Should this stream of words go unanswered . . . and such a speaker . . . be vindicated
verses.literalPt: Porventura não se dará resposta à multidão de palavras? E o homem falador será justificado?

verses.original: בַּ֭דֶּיךָ מְתִ֣ים יַחֲרִ֑ישׁו וַ֝תִּלְעַ֗ג וְאֵ֣ין מַכְלִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bad·de·ḵā mə·ṯîm ya·ḥă·rī·šw wat·til·‘aḡ wə·’ên maḵ·lim
verses.literal: Should your babbling put others to silence Will you scoff without rebuke
verses.literalPt: Às tuas mentiras se hão de calar os homens? E zombarás tu sem que ninguém te envergonhe?

verses.original: וַ֭תֹּאמֶר זַ֣ךְ לִקְחִ֑י וּ֝בַ֗ר הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer zaḵ liq·ḥî ū·ḇar hā·yî·ṯî ḇə·‘ê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: You have said My doctrine is sound and I am pure in Your sight
verses.literalPt: Pois dizes: A minha doutrina é pura, e limpo sou aos teus olhos.

verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן אֱל֣וֹהַּ דַּבֵּ֑ר וְיִפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתָ֣יו עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām mî- yit·tên ’ĕ·lō·w·ah dab·bêr wə·yip̄·taḥ śə·p̄ā·ṯāw ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: But if only . . . God would speak and open His lips against you
verses.literalPt: Mas na verdade, quem dera que Deus falasse e abrisse os seus lábios contra ti!

verses.original: וְיַגֶּד־ לְךָ֨׀ תַּֽעֲלֻמ֣וֹת חָכְמָה֮ כִּֽי־ כִפְלַ֪יִם לְֽת֫וּשִׁיָּ֥ה וְדַ֡ע כִּֽי־ יַשֶּׁ֥ה לְךָ֥ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵעֲוֺנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yag·geḏ- lə·ḵā ta·‘ă·lu·mō·wṯ ḥāḵ·māh kî- ḵip̄·la·yim lə·ṯū·šî·yāh wə·ḏa‘ kî- yaš·šeh lə·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·w·ha mê·‘ă·wō·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: and disclose to you the secrets of wisdom for true wisdom has two sides Know then that God exacts from you less than your iniquity deserves
verses.literalPt: E te fizesse saber os segredos da sabedoria, que é multíplice em eficácia; sabe, pois, que Deus exige de ti menos do que merece a tua iniqüidade.

verses.original: הַחֵ֣קֶר אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּמְצָ֑א אִ֤ם עַד־ תַּכְלִ֖ית שַׁדַּ֣י תִּמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥê·qer ’ĕ·lō·w·ha tim·ṣā ’im ‘aḏ- taḵ·lîṯ šad·day tim·ṣā
verses.literal: Can you fathom the deep things of God or . . . discover the limits of the Almighty
verses.literalPt: Porventura alcançarás os caminhos de Deus, ou chegarás à perfeição do Todo-Poderoso?

verses.original: גָּבְהֵ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם מַה־ תִּפְעָ֑ל עֲמֻקָּ֥ה מִ֝שְּׁא֗וֹל מַה־ תֵּדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: gā·ḇə·hê šā·ma·yim mah- tip̄·‘āl ‘ă·muq·qāh miš·šə·’ō·wl mah- tê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: They are higher than the heavens what can you do They are deeper than Sheol what can you know
verses.literalPt: Como as alturas dos céus é a sua sabedoria; que poderás tu fazer? É mais profunda do que o inferno, que poderás tu saber?

verses.original: אֲרֻכָּ֣ה מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִדָּ֑הּ וּ֝רְחָבָ֗ה מִנִּי־ יָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ruk·kāh mê·’e·reṣ mid·dāh ū·rə·ḥā·ḇāh min·nî- yām
verses.literal: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea
verses.literalPt: Mais comprida é a sua medida do que a terra, e mais larga do que o mar.

verses.original: אִם־ יַחֲלֹ֥ף וְיַסְגִּ֑יר וְ֝יַקְהִ֗יל וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ya·ḥă·lōp̄ wə·yas·gîr wə·yaq·hîl ū·mî yə·šî·ḇen·nū
verses.literal: If He comes along to imprison you or convenes a court who can stop Him
verses.literalPt: Se ele passar, aprisionar, ou chamar a juízo, quem o impedirá?

verses.original: כִּי־ ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע מְתֵי־ שָׁ֑וְא וַיַּרְא־ אָ֝֗וֶן וְלֹ֣א יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hū yā·ḏa‘ mə·ṯê- šāw way·yar- ’ā·wen wə·lō yiṯ·bō·w·nān
verses.literal: Surely He knows the deceit of men If He sees iniquity does He not take note
verses.literalPt: Porque ele conhece aos homens vãos, e vê o vício; e não o terá em consideração?

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ נָ֭בוּב יִלָּבֵ֑ב וְעַ֥יִר פֶּ֝֗רֶא אָדָ֥ם יִוָּלֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš nā·ḇūḇ yil·lā·ḇêḇ wə·‘a·yir pe·re ’ā·ḏām yiw·wā·lêḏ
verses.literal: But a witless man can no more become wise than the colt of a wild donkey can be born a man
verses.literalPt: Mas o homem vão é falto de entendimento; sim, o homem nasce como a cria do jumento montês.

verses.original: אִם־ אַ֭תָּ֗ה הֲכִינ֣וֹתָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ֖ אֵלָ֣יו כַּפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ʾat·tå̄h hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯā lib·be·ḵā ū·p̄ā·raś·tā ’ê·lāw kap·pe·ḵā
verses.literal: As for you if you direct your heart and lift up your hands to Him
verses.literalPt: Se tu preparares o teu coração, e estenderes as tuas mãos para ele;

verses.original: אִם־ אָ֣וֶן בְּ֭יָדְךָ הַרְחִיקֵ֑הוּ וְאַל־ תַּשְׁכֵּ֖ן בְּאֹהָלֶ֣יךָ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ā·wen bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā har·ḥî·qê·hū wə·’al- taš·kên bə·’ō·hā·le·ḵā ‘aw·lāh
verses.literal: if you put away the iniquity in your hand and allow no injustice to dwell in your tents
verses.literalPt: Se há iniqüidade na tua mão, lança-a para longe de ti e não deixes habitar a injustiça nas tuas tendas.

verses.original: כִּי־ אָ֤ז׀ תִּשָּׂ֣א פָנֶ֣יךָ מִמּ֑וּם וְהָיִ֥יתָ מֻ֝צָ֗ק וְלֹ֣א תִירָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’āz tiś·śā p̄ā·ne·ḵā mim·mūm wə·hā·yî·ṯā mu·ṣāq wə·lō ṯî·rā
verses.literal: then indeed you will lift up your face without blemish you will stand firm and unafraid . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque então o teu rosto levantarás sem mácula; e estarás firme, e não temerás.

verses.original: כִּי־ אַ֭תָּה עָמָ֣ל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח כְּמַ֖יִם עָבְר֣וּ תִזְכֹּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ‘ā·māl tiš·kāḥ kə·ma·yim ‘ā·ḇə·rū ṯiz·kōr
verses.literal: For you will forget your misery recalling it only as waters gone by
verses.literalPt: Porque te esquecerás do cansaço, e lembrar-te-ás dele como das águas que já passaram.

verses.original: וּֽ֭מִצָּהֳרַיִם יָק֣וּם חָ֑לֶד תָּ֝עֻ֗פָה כַּבֹּ֥קֶר תִּהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miṣ·ṣā·ho·ra·yim yā·qūm ḥā·leḏ tā·‘u·p̄āh kab·bō·qer tih·yeh
verses.literal: Your life will be brighter than noonday its darkness will be like the morning
verses.literalPt: E a tua vida mais clara se levantará do que o meio dia; ainda que haja trevas, será como a manhã.

verses.original: וּֽ֭בָטַחְתָּ כִּי־ יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝חָפַרְתָּ֗ לָבֶ֥טַח תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·ṭaḥ·tā kî- yêš tiq·wāh wə·ḥā·p̄ar·tā lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ tiš·kāḇ
verses.literal: You will be secure because there is hope and you will look around and lie down in safety
verses.literalPt: E terás confiança, porque haverá esperança; olharás em volta e repousarás seguro.

verses.original: וְֽ֭רָבַצְתָּ וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְחִלּ֖וּ פָנֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḇaṣ·tā wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ wə·ḥil·lū p̄ā·ne·ḵā rab·bîm
verses.literal: You will lie down without fear and many will court your favor
verses.literalPt: E deitar-te-ás, e ninguém te espantará; muitos suplicarão o teu favor.

verses.original: וְעֵינֵ֥י רְשָׁעִ֗ים תִּ֫כְלֶ֥ינָה וּ֭מָנוֹס אָבַ֣ד מִנְהֶ֑ם וְ֝תִקְוָתָ֗ם מַֽפַּח־ נָֽפֶשׁ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ê·nê rə·šā·‘îm tiḵ·le·nāh ū·mā·nō·ws ’ā·ḇaḏ min·hem wə·ṯiq·wā·ṯām map·paḥ- nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: But the eyes of the wicked will fail and escape will elude them . . . they will hope for their last breath . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém os olhos dos ímpios desfalecerão, e perecerá o seu refúgio; e a sua esperança será o expirar da alma.
